Patient Financial Engagement Survey
How can healthcare systems improve their engagement with consumers following the pandemic?
COVID-19 shed a new light on every facet of the healthcare industry, including the need to optimize the patient financial experience. Healthcare systems are beginning to adopt innovative solutions to better accommodate their consumers' modern day demands.
‌
Flywire conducted an independent survey of 2000+ adults in the United States to understand the consumer opinion on major issues impacting healthcare today, including:
‌
The cost of medical expenses The process of paying for medical care Adapting to a new hybrid model of healthcare
